text: Coverage in Pakistan was mainly taken with a Generation 3** trekker** camera.
text_zh: 巴基斯坦的街景覆蓋主要使用第 3 代**徒步拍攝**相機拍攝。

text: While many languages are spoken in Pakistan, Urdu is considered the National language and most commonly found on signage. It is written in the [Urdu alphabet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urdu_alphabet), which is closely related to the Arabic alphabet and may appear almost indistinguishable, however Urdu often uses softer and curvier fonts.
Notably, [English](https://goo.gl/maps/Arq4sy3Xs784b4h18) is also an official language in Pakistan and is fairly common on signage.
text_zh: 雖然巴基斯坦使用許多語言，但烏都語被視為國語，最常出現在招牌上。它是用[烏都字母](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urdu_alphabet)書寫，與阿拉伯字母密切相關，可能看起來幾乎無法區分，不過烏都語通常使用更柔和、更彎曲的字型。
值得注意的是，[英文](https://goo.gl/maps/Arq4sy3Xs784b4h18)也是巴基斯坦的官方語言，在招牌上相當常見。

text: Pakistan uses **short** licence plates and each region has its unique design. However, as all of the coverage was taken in Punjab, most plates will have the Punjab design, with a **green strip** on the left side. [Fully green plates](https://www.google.com/maps/@31.5699275,74.3126068,2a,15y,346.42h,75.04t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sFje7OKBVT_esVcdJIZy0BQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) are also fairly common.
NOTE: India primarily uses long licence plates.
text_zh: 巴基斯坦使用**短**車牌，每個地區都有其獨特的設計。然而，由於所有街景覆蓋都是在旁遮普拍攝的，大多數車牌都會採用旁遮普設計，左側有一條**綠色帶子**。[全綠車牌](https://www.google.com/maps/@31.5699275,74.3126068,2a,15y,346.42h,75.04t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sFje7OKBVT_esVcdJIZy0BQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)也相當常見。
注意：印度主要使用長車牌。

text: A significant portion of the Pakistani coverage was taken in large, well ordered gardens, often surrounded by stone walls and in combination with old temples or fortresses. This type of garden is typically referred to as a [Mughal garden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mughal_garden).
text_zh: 巴基斯坦的大部分街景拍攝於大型且井然有序的花園中，四周通常圍著石牆，並結合了古老的神廟或堡壘。這類花園通常被稱為[莫臥兒式花園](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mughal_garden)。

text: Typically brightly coloured, **baggy pants** are very common in Pakistan.

NOTE: This is mostly useful to differentiate it from Generation 3 trekkers in [India](https://www.google.com/maps/@28.3597449,75.5836959,3a,47.8y,328.5h,69.24t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sUQeRSW7849ilaZajHH6AyQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu), where pants tend to be tighter.
text_zh: 通常顏色鮮豔、**寬鬆的褲子**在巴基斯坦非常常見。
注意：這主要有助於將其與[印度](https://www.google.com/maps/@28.3597449,75.5836959,3a,47.8y,328.5h,69.24t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sUQeRSW7849ilaZajHH6AyQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)的第 3 代徒步拍攝區分開來，那裡的褲子通常比較緊。

text: Coverage in Pakistan is extremely limited, only being found in Punjab around major temples and tourist attractions.
Due to the number of distinct coverage spots, this section will only focus on the parts that are considered pinpointable.
text_zh: 巴基斯坦的街景非常有限，僅能在旁遮普的大型神廟和旅遊景點周邊找到。
由於有許多不同的街景拍攝點，本節將只著眼於那些可以精準定位的部分。

text: You may find this **grey car**, with a **visible right side**, driving around Lahore Fort in the north of Lahore.

NOTE: This is considered hidden coverage, as it can not be accessed normally on Google Maps. It can however be accessed in the [Map Making App](https://map-making.app/) and is still included in some community-made maps.
text_zh: 你可能會在拉合爾北部拉合爾堡周邊看到這輛**灰色車**，且**右側車身清晰可見**。
注意：這被視為隱藏街景，因為它無法在 Google 地圖上正常訪問。不過，它可以在[地圖製作應用程式](https://map-making.app/)中訪問，並且仍被包含在一些社群製作的地圖中。

text: Just south of Lahore Fort you can find a trekker walking around some narrow urban streets that are typically very busy.
NOTE: This is also hidden coverage.
text_zh: 就在拉合爾堡的正南方，你可以找到一個徒步拍攝，漫步於一些通常非常擁擠的狹窄市區街道。
注意：這也是隱藏街景。

text: Lahore Fort is a large fortress in Lahore, with the [Alamgiri Gate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lahore_Fort#Alamgiri_Gate) being one of the most iconic monuments in Pakistan.
text_zh: 拉合爾堡是拉合爾的一座大型堡壘，其中的[阿拉姆吉爾門](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lahore_Fort#Alamgiri_Gate)是巴基斯坦最具代表性的古蹟之一。

text: Inside Lahore Fort you may find this road completely surrounded by tall **red brick walls** on both sides.
text_zh: 在拉合爾堡內部，你可能會發現這條道路兩側完全被高大的**紅磚牆**包圍。

text: The Government College University of Lahore can be recognised by its **gothic architecture**.
text_zh: 拉合爾政府學院大學可以透過其**哥德式建築**來辨識。

text: The Patiala Block of King Edward Medical University in Lahore is a large white colonial building with large white domes having black lines going around them.
text_zh: 位於拉合爾的愛德華國王醫科大學帕蒂亞拉樓是一棟大型白色殖民風格建築，擁有大型白色圓頂，圓頂周圍有黑色線條。

text: Kinnaird College for Women University is mainly made up of traditional Pakistani red brick buildings, often combined with red brick paths.
text_zh: 金納德女子大學主要由傳統的巴基斯坦紅磚建築組成，通常搭配紅磚小徑。

text: The coverage in Jallo, an eastern suburb of Lahore, can be recognised by the semi-urban coverage in a fairly poor-looking neighbourhood, with a very thick haze.
text_zh: 位於拉合爾東部郊區賈洛的街景，可以透過貧民區風格的半市區街景以及非常濃厚的霧霾來辨識。

text: Bahria Grand Hotel, in the southwestern suburbs of Lahore, can be recognised by the minigolf course in front of the hotel. There is also a [statue of a cow](https://goo.gl/maps/8LkJjyWg9pe76Yc3A) by the entrance to the hotel grounds.
text_zh: 位於拉合爾西南郊區的巴利亞大飯店，可以透過飯店前方的迷你高爾夫球場來辨識。飯店園區入口處還有一座[乳牛雕像](https://goo.gl/maps/8LkJjyWg9pe76Yc3A)。

text: West of Sahiwal, just northwest of Harappa, you can find a trekker starting in the south at Harappa Museum. This trekker can be recognised by most of the coverage being taken on a very** narrow path **made of **concrete**.
text_zh: 在薩希瓦爾以西、哈拉帕西北方，你可以找到一個從南邊哈拉帕博物館開始的徒步拍攝。這個徒步拍攝的特徵是大部分街景都是在一條由**混凝土**製成的非常**狹窄的小徑**上拍攝的。

text: Hiran Minar is a small temple, completely surrounded by a small lake with a single bridge connecting it to land, can be found just northwest of the city of Sheikhupura.
text_zh: 希蘭米納爾是一座小神廟，四周完全被一座小湖環繞，只有一座單一橋樑將其與陸地相連，位於謝胡布爾城西北方。

text: The coverage around the shrine of Hazrat Baba Bulleh Shah, in western Kasur, can typically be recognised by the mosque with a large green dome, and two smaller green domes on top of the minarets. While the mosque itself isn’t visible from all of the coverage, [the minarets](https://goo.gl/maps/HJ1Aqz2jAFaWjF6JA) can be seen from most spots.
text_zh: 卡蘇爾西部的哈茲拉特·巴巴·布勒·沙阿神廟周邊的街景，通常可以透過那座清真寺來辨識，該清真寺有一個大綠圓頂，宣禮塔頂部有兩個較小的綠圓頂。雖然從所有街景中不一定能直接看到清真寺本身，但從多數地點都可以看到[宣禮塔](https://goo.gl/maps/HJ1Aqz2jAFaWjF6JA)。

text: In Pākpattan you can find a **busy market street** with a roof made of rugs.
NOTE: Like the car coverage in Lahore, this, and the rest of the coverage in Pākpattan, is hidden coverage.
text_zh: 在帕克帕坦（Pākpattan）你可以找到一條用毯子做成屋頂的**繁忙市場街道**。
註：就像拉合爾（Lahore）的車輛覆蓋一樣，這裡以及帕克帕坦其餘的覆蓋都是隱藏式街景覆蓋。

text: Just west of the market street in Pākpattan you can find a very **busy-looking** urban street.
text_zh: 就在帕克帕坦市場街道的西方，你可以找到一條看起來非常**繁忙**的市區街道。

text: You can also find this **narrow alleyway** in Pākpattan, just north of the market street.
text_zh: 你也可以在帕克帕坦找到這條**狹窄小巷**，就在市場街道的北方。

text: Rohtas Fort, west of Jhelum, can typically be recognised by the almost **black fortress walls**. While the walls aren’t always nearby, they can usually be seen in [the distance](https://goo.gl/maps/uh16izrHsXQTanN98).
text_zh: 傑赫勒姆（Jhelum）西方的羅塔斯堡（Rohtas Fort），通常可以透過幾乎是**黑色的要塞城牆**來辨識。雖然城牆不一定就在附近，但通常可以在[遠處](https://goo.gl/maps/uh16izrHsXQTanN98)看到它們。

text: The coverage in Katas, north of Sargodha, can be recognised by the hazy sky combined with the **hilliness**.
text_zh: 薩戈達（Sargodha）北方的卡塔斯（Katas）街景覆蓋，可以透過霧濛濛的天空結合**丘陵地形**來辨識。

text: Patriata, northeast of Islamabad can be recognised by the **hilly forests**, mainly consisting of **tall pine trees**. Interestingly, parts of the coverage were taken from an [aerial lift](https://goo.gl/maps/sa5D6rT9i6EcbGYy8).
text_zh: 伊斯蘭瑪巴德（Islamabad）東北方的帕特里亞塔（Patriata）可以透過**多山森林**來辨識，主要由**高大的松樹**組成。有趣的是，部分街景覆蓋是從[空中纜車](https://goo.gl/maps/sa5D6rT9i6EcbGYy8)上拍攝的。

text: The coverage in Changa Manga Forest Park can be recognised by the path angle being northeastern, and the narrow channel closely following the path, either on the northern or [southern](https://goo.gl/maps/bAPXGSaAF1SUyPun6) side.
text_zh: 昌加曼加森林公園（Changa Manga Forest Park）的街景覆蓋可以透過路徑角度為東北東、以及緊鄰路徑的狹窄水道來辨識，水道位於北方或[南方](https://goo.gl/maps/bAPXGSaAF1SUyPun6)側。
